sources.notes: The claim contrasts reactive VLA policies with predictive, action-conditioned models; search must cover failure/recovery, physical admissibility, 4D/contact dynamics, and VLA-world-model fusion.

queries.label: dynamic-reactive-vla-limit
queries.query: (all:VLA OR all:"vision-language-action") AND (all:reactive OR all:"error accumulation" OR all:recovery) AND all:robot
queries.why: Test the narrow claim that reactive next-action policies break on long-horizon execution and recovery.

queries.label: dynamic-vla-world-model-fusion
queries.query: (all:VLA OR all:"vision-language-action") AND all:"world model" AND all:robot
queries.why: Look for fusion rather than replacement between VLA policies and world models.

queries.label: dynamic-world-action-model
queries.query: (all:"world action model" OR all:"world-action model") AND all:robot
queries.why: Capture models that jointly represent actions and predicted futures.

queries.label: dynamic-world-model-action-reliability
queries.query: all:"world model" AND (all:"action fidelity" OR all:"physics adherence" OR all:"failure optimism") AND all:robot
queries.why: Distinguish useful predictive models from visually plausible but decision-invalid video generators.

queries.label: dynamic-world-model-contact-recovery
queries.query: all:"world model" AND (all:tactile OR all:force OR all:contact) AND (all:recovery OR all:correction) AND all:robot
queries.why: Cover contact-rich tasks where RGB-only futures are partially observable.

queries.label: dynamic-vla-benchmark-memorization
queries.query: (all:VLA OR all:"vision-language-action") AND (all:memorization OR all:"benchmark leakage" OR all:overfit)
queries.why: Check whether standard benchmark gains overstate physical generalization.

browser_fallback_queries.label: dynamic-vla-world-model-browser
browser_fallback_queries.query: site:arxiv.org/abs VLA world model robot action fidelity recovery
browser_fallback_queries.why: Fallback discovery for newly submitted fusion and evaluation papers.

web_calibration_queries.label: dynamic-world-language-action-web
web_calibration_queries.why: Calibrate the emerging WLA naming used by recent papers.
